result: No concrete Firefox incompatibility found in the bounded covered flows; no production fix recommended.

setup.scope: Browser cache installation only. No dependency or production source changes. Temporary nonpersistent browser contexts; no shared browser profile touched.

phases.name: preliminary launch
phases.result: Default headless launch showed WebGL and no page exception; diagnostic only, no game orders.

phases.name: initial-driver-phase
phases.result: Stopped after three Tabs from construction close landed on Colony charter, not Ships. Firefox inserts a native focus stop on scrollable .modal-content; the Chromium-specific fixed Tab count was an invalid driver assumption. Source, failure, screenshot and partial receipts preserved.

phases.name: accepted phase
phases.result: Tab to the target through actual keyboard navigation, then verify activation, retained focus, adjacent Tab and Shift+Tab, ARIA state, Escape return and exact unchanged state. All requested flows pass.

driverCorrections: Use target-based keyboard traversal instead of assuming Chromium's exact number of Tab stops.

Before the accepted phase reached them, correct the research filter selector to case-sensitive All and the guide heading expectation to its actual Find your place text. These were driver expectations, not product defects.

graphics.observed: Visible Three.js starfield, starlanes and map labels with a live WebGL2 context; fallback false and canvas visible.
graphics.renderer: Firefox reports Radeon R9 200 Series, or similar / AMD; this string is not an independent physical GPU attestation.
graphics.warnings: Depth-texture filtering warning occurs once per initialized page. No rendering failure was observed. The deprecated WEBGL_debug_renderer_info warning was caused by the audit's diagnostic query, not normal game UI.

coverage.viewport: 1440 ×1000, Linux headless Firefox, reduced motion requested
ordinaryCommands: Move own Pathfinder f1 from Solace to charted neighbor s28 (1 Order)
Commission frigate at Solace (1 Order,25 credits,35 minerals)
coverage.keyboard: Construction Infrastructure/Colony charter/Ships; research Engineering/Society; Chronicle Discovery/Construction; Enter/Space, Tab/ShiftTab and construction Escape focus return.
coverage.save: Export compatibility cycle2, actual picker import, autosave reload; all exact. Separately import immutable actual ODYSSEY cycle66, inspect conclusion and retained rounds, export and reload; exact original bytes and state.
coverage.guide: Open real popup, follow combat contents anchor, return to game and compare shared autosave.

limits: A bounded browser acceptance audit, not a fresh completed campaign, performance benchmark, all-browser certification or replication of the full Chromium suite.
One desktop viewport and one Linux Firefox build; other operating systems, headed window managers, assistive technology and long sessions were not tested.
The tactical fallback was not exercised because WebGL worked. No fallback-support conclusion is inferred.

The results scope uses 'player orders' generically; there were three command invocations but only two Order-resource costs. Research is free, and exact command-state comparisons preserve that distinction.
sourcePhase: Build metadata pins base3c6e822; source main/guide/package carry the existing near-final focus/ARIA/guide working-tree changes. Exact source hashes, tracked-diff hash and served build asset hashes are retained rather than misrepresenting the worktree as clean.
